name: Mother: Invasion From the Unknown
source:
MOTHER: Invasion from the Unknown is a visual novel adaptation of the official choose-your-own-adventure book, based on MOTHER / EarthBound Beginnings.

[From https://x.com/EarthBoundVN/status/2086574169232183565]
translation:
《地球冒险：未知的入侵》是一款改编自《地球冒险》（MOTHER）官方同名互动游戏书的视觉小说。

[摘自https://x.com/EarthBoundVN/status/2086574169232183565]
